base.title: Studio and local generation
base.summary: Projects, editors, Director, Wizard and local NVIDIA generation (WanGP, including native MiniMax H3). Always installed.

components.title: FLUX 3 / Drama 3 Support
components.summary: Isolated ComfyUI runtime for FLUX 3 Klein images and Drama 3 voices.

components.title: 3D Generation (Hunyuan3D)
components.summary: Local image-to-3D meshes and textures. On Windows it also needs Visual Studio Build Tools.

components.title: TRELLIS.2 (optional, Linux NVIDIA 24GB)
components.summary: Official Microsoft 4B image-to-3D. Linux with an NVIDIA GPU of 24 GB or more.

components.title: AI Rigging (UniRig)
components.summary: Automatic skeletons for 3D characters. Linux only.

components.title: Make-It-Animatable
components.summary: Rigs a humanoid in any pose, including meshes the standard humanoid rig refuses (turned, hands against the body, not upright). Linux x64 only. Code is MIT (Zhiyang Guo); the demo weights are Apache-2.0. The Mixamo bones.fbx template has no stated dataset licence and is downloaded at install (about 70 KB), not stored in git. Blender (bpy) writes the skinned file; importing the upstream app also loads that template with bpy. About 8 GB is an estimate: the five demo weight files are 2.33 GB on disk and the environment was not measured. Does not switch engines by itself.

components.title: MiniMax H3 Legacy (ComfyUI)
components.summary: The original ComfyUI workflow for MiniMax H3. The native H3 in the base install covers normal use.

components.title: Template semantic search
components.summary: Spanish and English template search on CPU. Downloads intfloat/multilingual-e5-small (MIT, about 0.5 GB) and uses the studio's transformers. Without it, search stays lexical.

components.title: Anime face landmarks
components.summary: 28-point anime face landmarks for the flat rig, on CPU. The package and the Hugging Face weights are MIT. Vendored mmpose, mmdet and mmcv code is Apache-2.0. Linux x64, Windows x64 and Apple Silicon.

components.title: See-through
components.summary: Split one illustration into RGBA layers (eyes, mouth, hair) for the flat rig. Linux NVIDIA only, about 8 GB of VRAM with the NF4 pipeline and about 12 GB of disk. Code Apache-2.0, weights OpenRAIL++.
